    The mesh sequences of k(Γ_A) on homogeneous paths #

    Proposition 2.6(1)(2) transported to k(Γ_A) = C(Γ_A, c) through the realization of Proposition 2.6(3). For a homogeneous family of morphisms of kQ the statements read, modulo the mesh ideal:

    • (cov_homog) if ∑_a G_a a lies in the mesh ideal, then at a projective vertex every G_a does, and at a nonprojective vertex y there is H with G_a ≡ c_{y,a} H (σa) for every arrow a ending at y (that paper's "comes from h ∈ C_{n-2}(W, τY)", as in the injectivity step of (3));
    • (cov_mono_homog) if every H (σa) lies in the mesh ideal, so does H;
    • (contra_homog) if ∑_a c_{y,a} (σa) V_a lies in the mesh ideal, then V_a ≡ a U for one U;
    • (contra_mono_homog) if every a U lies in the mesh ideal, so does U.

    The first two use the first sequence of (1), the last two the second sequence (LayerExactnessDual.lean).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    A homogeneous element of the mesh ideal is realized one radical degree higher.

    Proposition 2.6(1) for k(Γ_A), second sequence, exactness on homogeneous families: if ∑_a c_{y,a} (σa) V_a lies in the mesh ideal, then V_a ≡ a U for one U.
